title: Wrong Scope Sixth Time (COR Two One Eight)
style: incident ledger rap, 88 bpm, persistent groove, deadpan precision, scope blocker anthem, COR-218 echo, dry hi-hat, ops fatigue, terminal core
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sixth time the token scope hits the wall
COR two one eight from sixteen days ago recall
Zone create token zone read DNS edit
No Pages edit so the deploy gets credit denied

[Pre-Chorus]
Four tokens on the VDS none can push Pages
Same blocker different stages

[Chorus]
Wrong scope wrong scope sixth time around
The incident sits in archive ground
For proton upload twenty twenty six oh four twenty one
Same line same gap same run

[Verse 2]
Account Cloudflare Pages edit the missing key
Account account settings read complete the spree
Forty eight site deploy keeps repeating the block
A five minute token regen unlocks the dock

[Bridge]
The gap isn't writing it's the token in the env
Replace one variable thirty six sites get the heaven

[Outro]
Wrong scope wrong scope same wall again
Five minute regen or path A click ten
